text:
maria: Heads-up — we need extra A100 quota in us-west1 for the new Dedicated pool rollout next week. Target is 6x A100 per pool, 3 pools total. Who can confirm current quota and vendor ETA? cc @josh :wave:

josh: I can check the GCP console now. Last org-level quota I saw was 12 A100 in us-west1. If that's still true we need an increase — typical request is 2-3 business days.

tess: Also want to check if our Baremetal partner has spare nodes we can use for an initial canary while cloud quota is pending.

sam: Pinged vendor this morning — they say 10 GPUs available to reserve in us-west1 but require PO + contract sign-off. I can draft the PO.

infra-bot: quota-script output:
```
$ gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format=json
{
  "quotas": [
    {"metric":"GPUS", "limit": 12, "usage": 4},
    {"metric":"GPUS_A100", "limit": 12, "usage": 4}
  ]
}
```
Quick summary: effective A100 limit = 12, used = 4.

liam: FYI the standard quota flow is 48-72h. If we escalate with billing agent we can sometimes get 24-48h turnaround.

maria: For the canary we only need 2 A100s by Monday. If quota increase is slow, can we ask vendor for a short-term reservation or use smaller GPUs for the canary?

tess: If vendor can push 6 now we can spin up one pool and run a 50% traffic canary. Otherwise fallback to v100 or 8xA10G equivalent and re-run perf. Need to validate perf delta.

sam: PO draft link: https://internal.docs/purchase-orders/po-4821 (requires legal review). Vendor also asked for billing contact; they said "can provision upon receipt of signed PO and payment terms" — they mentioned a same-week ship if contract cleared.

josh: Filing quota increase ticket with GCP now. Tagging billing and infra leads. @anna can you escalate in billing if needed? I'll include requested limits: +12 A100 in us-west1 to cover 3 pools.

anna: Added billing and escalated the ticket (support #9876543). Agent quoted ETA ~36h after escalation. I dropped notes about the canary Monday ask. :white_check_mark: 

maria: Great — I'll pause the product canary schedule until we confirm. Plan B: spin canary on smaller GPUs Tue morning if quota/vendor delayed.

liam: One more ops check — can someone confirm node-autoscaler and GKE node-pool limits can handle 3 new A100 pools? We might need to bump node-pool size limits and adjust autoscaler cooldowns.

tess: I'll run a quick capacity sim and post results in this thread (give me 30m).

infra-bot: Created support ticket link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876543 — status: escalated.

maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up once PO/legal and quota are confirmed. If anyone can reserve a vendor buffer for the canary, please ping me here. :pray:
